published_implementation.historical_relation: The source studies workflow capability packs injected into a fixed Codex CLI execution harness. The five admitted arms share the same reported primary model and core eight-task panel, but the source aggregates multiple frozen campaigns rather than one single randomized scheduler batch. W1 preserves the workflow-arm identities without canonical harness linkage.

benchmark.name: Workflow Arena eight-task core workflow panel

execution.evaluator: two independent treatment-label-blinded model judges; per-run judge mean, then task mean, then equal-weight eight-task macro mean
execution.environment: task-specific frozen baseline commit in isolated worktree; no remote/upstream history; network and web search disabled; isolated CODEX_HOME; hidden ground truth, reference implementation, rubric, and focused tests unavailable to candidate
execution.reset_and_adaptation: fresh independent candidate runs; failures, timeouts, and incomplete trajectories retained

unknown_dimensions: exact Codex CLI build/version shared by all historical campaigns
task-specific frozen baseline commit identifiers are not carried in the aggregate matrix
campaign-level timing semantics are not fully uniform across all historical campaigns
observations.notes: Bare injects no external capability pack. The aggregate is descriptive evidence over a preselected diagnostic panel, not a population estimate.
